TABLE.NAME: local_reactions
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores emoji reactions on forum posts, database activity entries and blog entries

FIELD.NAME: itemtype
FIELD.COMMENT: Item type e.g. post, record, entry

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the item being reacted to

INDEX.NAME: user_item_emoji_unique
INDEX.COMMENT: One reaction per emoji per user per item

INDEX.NAME: item_lookup
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast lookup of all reactions for an item

TABLE.NAME: local_reactions_enabled
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-activity settings for emoji reactions, keyed by course module ID

FIELD.NAME: compactview_list
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = compact view on the multi-item page (forum discussion list, database list view)

FIELD.NAME: compactview_discuss
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = compact view on the single-item page (forum discussion, database single view)

FIELD.NAME: allowmultiplereactions
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = users may react with multiple emoji per item (default); 0 = single emoji per user per item

FIELD.NAME: onlypeerreactionsgrading
FIELD.COMMENT: Forum only: 1 = when grading, only show peer reactions (exclude self-reactions and reactions by non-students)
